# Prompt for the AI responsible for edbb.com

Review and implement the attached EDBB website-change report in a separate reviewable website branch/PR. Do not edit either documentation repository or the EDIS website. Do not merge or publish without Gerhard's approval. Read current repository/CMS instructions and recheck the current source and rendered pages before changing them.

Use `website-change-report.md` and `website-doc-link-mapping.csv` as the task and evidence list. Apply confirmed corrections W1–W6: conditional 24-hour refund exceptions in both Terms sections; 20 stable IPv6 addresses and qualified geolocation; PayPal-inclusive payment wording; assigned versus unassigned traffic expiry; realistic provisioning/installer wording; precise EDBB legal form and a consistent location catalogue. Update the homepage FAQPage acceptedAnswer values together with the visible FAQ, not just one representation. Locate shared components/CMS records before editing copies.

EDBB is operated by ED Backbone & Co, a legal partnership in Cyprus, and uses the EDIS Global resource pool. EDBB has its own panel, customers and plan specifications; the same EDBB VPS plan price applies globally. EDBB has no customer/order API, BYOIP, commercial /24-prefix offer or volume-business programme. A reseller programme is undecided. Annual billing provides 12 months for the price of 11 and must be retained; do not remove it under the older “no discounts” shorthand. No other discount is approved.

Every new VPS adds 100 GB starter pool credit. Unassigned pool traffic does not expire; unused assigned traffic expires at that VPS's next monthly refill. The verified traffic cart is https://my.edbb.com/cart.php?gid=214. Customers maintain routine backups. The separate manual qcow2 export costs EUR 25, with a password-protected download available for 30 days. Mehdi has supplied and confirmed the EDBB EUR bank PDF. The docs review branch includes it unchanged at `assets/edbb-eur-bank-details.pdf`. Use https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EDBB-docs/mintlify-docs/main/assets/edbb-eur-bank-details.pdf only after the approved docs release makes that URL available; never reuse EDIS banking details.

Use the report's exact replacement text where approved facts support it. For W7–W11, request evidence for uptime/support/network specifications or use the clearly identified non-promissory fallback proposed in the report. Do not invent an SLA, refund entitlement, statutory interpretation, legal retention period, network peering, guaranteed throughput or response time. Keep accounting record retention separate from VPS disk deletion. Retain the existing provider-initiated termination refund provision when editing Terms.

Search all website routes, shared feature blocks, CMS rich text, metadata and JSON-LD for conflicting API, prefix, reseller, backup, SMTP, DDoS, billing, traffic, location-count and support claims. Preserve customer-hosted API examples and valid network /24 examples. Use support@edbb.com and abuse@edbb.com. Keep the intentional shared https://status.edis.global/ resource and EDBB panel links. Preserve the existing historical speed-test caveats.

Use the supplied full old-to-new documentation mapping to update actual website references. Distinguish URLs found in your source from migration candidates. The sampled homepage panel/support and legal AUP links keep their existing paths. Do not point users to new documentation paths before they are deployed: prepare link changes now, release only after the approved documentation PR has published the destinations and redirects. Verify permanent redirects, final canonical URLs and representative fragment and Markdown-export routes on the hosted docs.

Validate the website build and links, compare visible answers with FAQPage JSON-LD, inspect plan cards/comparison tables and mobile layouts, and verify metadata and prices against the actual shared EDBB product data. Do not modify commercial values merely to match EDIS plans. Deliver the website PR, changed-page/component list, before/after claim matrix, verification evidence, remaining owner decisions and release-order checklist. Do not send messages or publish automatically.
